raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`InputBatch.make_dummy()` sets `dcp_local_seq_lens=None`. With DCP enabled, dummy runs pass this value to attention metadata builders and crash.

We observed this in CI with TP=2 and DCP=2 during FlashInfer autotuning:

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/executor/multiproc_executor.py", line 992, in worker_busy_loop
    output = func(*args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/tracing/otel.py", line 178, in sync_wrapper
    return func(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py", line 635, in compile_or_warm_up_model
    kernel_warmup(self)
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/model_executor/warmup/kernel_warmup.py", line 80, in kernel_warmup
    flashinfer_autotune(worker.model_runner)
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/model_executor/warmup/kernel_warmup.py", line 139, in flashinfer_autotune
    runner._dummy_run(
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/torch/utils/_contextlib.py", line 124, in decorate_context
    return func(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/eplb_utils.py", line 40, in wrapper
    result = fn(self, *args, **kwargs)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py", line 589, in _dummy_run
    self.execute_model(
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/torch/utils/_contextlib.py", line 124, in decorate_context
    return func(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py", line 1223, in execute_model
    attn_metadata = self.model_state.prepare_attn(
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/default.py", line 181, in prepare_attn
    attn_metadata = build_attn_metadata(
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/attn_utils.py", line 474, in build_attn_metadata
    metadata = attn_metadata_builder.build(
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib64/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py", line 2177, in build
    seq_lens_device=seq_lens[:num_decodes],
                    ~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
```

This PR adds a helper that computes `dcp_local_seq_lens` into the persistent input buffer and assigns the padded view to the batch. It is called after batch finalization for normal and dummy execution, generic CUDA graph capture, and DFlash capture.

This replaces duplicated initialization in the existing call sites. Unlike #31166, it initializes the batch instead of repairing missing metadata in a consumer.

Fixes #30736.

## Test Plan

```text
$ pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py
......                                                                   [100%]
6 passed
```

The added unit tests cover DCP initialization, padded request views, and the non-DCP path. They fail without this change and pass with it. Our downstream fork CI is green.

nodes.body:
Thanks for this fix — I hit the same bug independently and can confirm, plus one more trigger path and a minimal workaround in case it's useful.

**Repro** (DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, 4xH20, vllm `9c8e90eb`, TP=4 / DCP=2):

```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
llm = LLM(model="DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat", tensor_parallel_size=4,
          decode_context_parallel_size=2, max_model_len=8192,
          gpu_memory_utilization=0.50, trust_remote_code=True)
llm.generate(["The capital of France is"], SamplingParams(max_tokens=32, temperature=0))
```

**Trigger path** (in addition to the FlashInfer-autotune dummy run in the PR description): the v0.21.0 *CUDA-graph memory-profiling* dummy run (enabled by default since v0.21.0) hits the same crash, via `compile_or_warm_up_model -> _dummy_run -> execute_model(dummy_run=True)`:

```
... -> model_states.default.prepare_attn -> attn_utils.build_attn_metadata
 -> mla_attention.py:2409  seq_lens_device=seq_lens[:num_decodes]
 TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
```

**Root cause** (matches the PR): `execute_model` only prepares DCP metadata on the real path — `if not dummy_run: input_batch = self.prepare_inputs(...)` ([model_runner.py:1540](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1540)), and the DCP prep lives inside `prepare_inputs` via `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens(...)` ([model_runner.py:1238-1249](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1238-L1249)). The dummy branch builds `input_batch` via `InputBatch.make_dummy` ([model_runner.py:1567-1575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1567-L1575)), which sets `seq_lens` but leaves `dcp_local_seq_lens=None`. With `dcp_world_size>1`, `MLAAttentionMetadataBuilder.build` reassigns `seq_lens = dcp_local_seq_lens` ([mla_attention.py:2395](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py#L2395)) and then `seq_lens[:num_decodes]` ([mla_attention.py:2409](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py#L2409)) crashes.

**Reference workaround** (minimal, validated end-to-end with a `vllm serve` + completion): mirror the real path's `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` in the dummy branch right after `make_dummy`:

```python
input_batch = InputBatch.make_dummy(...)            # existing
if self.use_dcp:
    prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens(
        self.input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens,
        self.input_buffers.seq_lens,
        dummy_num_reqs,
        self.dcp_size, self.dcp_rank, self.cp_interleave,
    )
    input_batch.dcp_local_seq_lens = (
        self.input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens[:dummy_num_reqs]
    )
```

Just sharing as a smaller-surface alternative; happy to adapt to whatever shape the maintainers prefer.

This pull request has merge conflicts that must be resolved before it can be
merged. Please rebase the PR, @TQCB.

https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/syncing-a-fork

**Suggestion**: The PR is currently 1 commit behind `main` and marked as `needs-rebase`. Since `maintainer_can_modify` is enabled, this can be resolved by rebasing onto the latest `main`:

```bash
git remote add upstream https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
git push --force-with-lease origin rraph/dcp-input-batch-metadata
```

Alternatively, if you prefer a smaller surface fix, the workaround shared by @quanxu2 in the comments — adding `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` directly after `make_dummy` in the dummy branch — could be a simpler interim solution while the broader refactor is reviewed.

Also, one minor naming thought: `maybe_prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` could be slightly misleading since it *always* sets `dcp_local_seq_lens` (either to the computed tensor or `None`). Consider `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens_for_batch` or `update_dcp_local_seq_lens` to emphasize that it is setting batch state, not conditionally preparing.

Gentle ping @TQCB — could you rebase this when you get a moment? The PR has been conflicting with main since Aug 26 and CI needs a maintainer kick.

We hit the same `'NoneType' object is not subscriptable` crash in our internal deployment through the dummy-run path with DCP > 1, so we are tracking this fix closely. Happy to help validate the rebased branch on our setup if that is useful.

If the consolidated refactor is going to take a while to land, an interim minimal patch along the lines of what @quanxu2 posted above would also unblock deployments in the meantime. Thanks!

Thanks for this fix — I hit the same bug independently and can confirm, plus one more trigger path and a minimal workaround in case it's useful.

**Repro** (DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, 4xH20, vllm `9c8e90eb`, TP=4 / DCP=2):

```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
llm = LLM(model="DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat", tensor_parallel_size=4,
          decode_context_parallel_size=2, max_model_len=8192,
          gpu_memory_utilization=0.50, trust_remote_code=True)
llm.generate(["The capital of France is"], SamplingParams(max_tokens=32, temperature=0))
```

**Trigger path** (in addition to the FlashInfer-autotune dummy run in the PR description): the v0.21.0 *CUDA-graph memory-profiling* dummy run (enabled by default since v0.21.0) hits the same crash, via `compile_or_warm_up_model -> _dummy_run -> execute_model(dummy_run=True)`:

```
... -> model_states.default.prepare_attn -> attn_utils.build_attn_metadata
 -> mla_attention.py:2409  seq_lens_device=seq_lens[:num_decodes]
 TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
```

**Root cause** (matches the PR): `execute_model` only prepares DCP metadata on the real path — `if not dummy_run: input_batch = self.prepare_inputs(...)` ([model_runner.py:1540](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1540)), and the DCP prep lives inside `prepare_inputs` via `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens(...)` ([model_runner.py:1238-1249](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1238-L1249)). The dummy branch builds `input_batch` via `InputBatch.make_dummy` ([model_runner.py:1567-1575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py#L1567-L1575)), which sets `seq_lens` but leaves `dcp_local_seq_lens=None`. With `dcp_world_size>1`, `MLAAttentionMetadataBuilder.build` reassigns `seq_lens = dcp_local_seq_lens` ([mla_attention.py:2395](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py#L2395)) and then `seq_lens[:num_decodes]` ([mla_attention.py:2409](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/9c8e90eb2637a863ca14e47fd436b10ed7ba6536/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py#L2409)) crashes.

**Reference workaround** (minimal, validated end-to-end with a `vllm serve` + completion): mirror the real path's `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` in the dummy branch right after `make_dummy`:

```python
input_batch = InputBatch.make_dummy(...)            # existing
if self.use_dcp:
    prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens(
        self.input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens,
        self.input_buffers.seq_lens,
        dummy_num_reqs,
        self.dcp_size, self.dcp_rank, self.cp_interleave,
    )
    input_batch.dcp_local_seq_lens = (
        self.input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens[:dummy_num_reqs]
    )
```

Just sharing as a smaller-surface alternative; happy to adapt to whatever shape the maintainers prefer.

Also, one minor naming thought: `maybe_prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` could be slightly misleading since it *always* sets `dcp_local_seq_lens` (either to the computed tensor or `None`). Consider `prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens_for_batch` or `update_dcp_local_seq_lens` to emphasize that it is setting batch state, not conditionally preparing.

We hit the same `'NoneType' object is not subscriptable` crash in our internal deployment through the dummy-run path with DCP > 1, so we are tracking this fix closely. Happy to help validate the rebased branch on our setup if that is useful.
